_note: Power consumed inside the habitat, in kWh per day, by channel. The eight categories are the habitat's metered power channels — crickets, science 1 and 2, living, table, food, water, hydroponics — each naming its Home Assistant energy meter as "sensor" (the entity id without "sensor.", habitat_power_<channel>_energie, content/home-assistant.json): a category's day reads that meter — the day's last reading less the day before's last, since the meter only grows — unless a figure is filed by hand for that day, which wins. The categories are yours to shape: rename a label (on the Habitat tab of mission control or here), add one without a meter to count by hand, remove one — the key is the stable name in the record, the label is what the station shows. Days filed by hand are "1": { "food": 1.1, "living": 0.5, ... }; a save is live within a couple of seconds. Emptied of its days by the reset; the categories stay.
